mentions.name: Radius
mentions.description: An events and community platform positioned as a fairer-priced alternative to Meetup.com, with organiser pricing that works for smaller groups. Recently shipped lightweight events called activities, which let people meet each other through things they are doing, e.g. "John is going for a cycle tomorrow". The author has been improving it since a prior Show HN launch and plans to re-launch.
mentions.problem: Meetup.com's organiser pricing is unfair for smaller groups.
mentions.audience: Community organisers of smaller groups and people looking to meet others through shared activities
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://radius.to/ - a Meetup.com alternative of sorts - with fairer organiser pricing for smaller groups. I posted a Show HN [1] here a while back, got tons of great feedback, and have been slowly improving it since, with little marketing. Planning a re-launch here soon.

Recently shipped lightweight events called activities, to allow people to meet each other more easily through things they're doing - i.e. "John is going for a cycle tomorrow".
mentions.author: radius89
